pr.title: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding

raw_findings.body: `[0]` is nil and `nil['id']` raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration and thus every upgrade/deploy and every fresh install of the application.
raw_findings.evidence:
category_id = execute("SELECT c.id FROM categories AS c
                        INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name
                        WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i
raw_findings.failure_mode: Migration raises NoMethodError on nil and the schema change fails mid-run.
raw_findings.impact: `[0]` is nil and `nil['id']` raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration and thus every upgrade/deploy and every fresh install of the application.
raw_findings.root_cause: New migration code indexes a PG::Result at [0] without checking that any row was returned.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Capture the result first and guard for emptiness, e.g. `row = execute(...).first; category_id = row ? row['id'].to_i : 0`, before calling `to_i`.
raw_findings.title: Migration dereferences an empty result set when `embed_category` setting is absent
raw_findings.trigger: Running `rake db:migrate` on any site that never set the `embed_category` site setting (the default `''` is not persisted in `site_settings`), or where the stored value does not match any category name, so the SELECT returns zero rows.

raw_findings.body: Rows are stored as `http://discourse.org`; because the raw INSERT bypasses the ActiveRecord `before_validation` stripping, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `lower(host)` against the bare hostname and never matches, so embedding silently stops working on those hosts after upgrade.
raw_findings.evidence: execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"
raw_findings.failure_mode: Migrated configuration becomes functionally dead data and referer checks reject previously allowed hosts.
raw_findings.impact: Rows are stored as `http://discourse.org`; because the raw INSERT bypasses the ActiveRecord `before_validation` stripping, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `lower(host)` against the bare hostname and never matches, so embedding silently stops working on those hosts after upgrade.
raw_findings.root_cause: The data migration copies legacy setting values into the new table without applying the normalization the model performs on save.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Normalize each value in the migration before inserting (strip leading `https?://`, any path, and surrounding whitespace/`\r`) so the stored host matches what `record_for_host` looks up.
raw_findings.title: Migration inserts host values verbatim, so `http://` prefixed hosts stop matching
raw_findings.trigger: A site whose old `embeddable_hosts` setting contained scheme-prefixed entries such as `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (explicitly supported by the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?`) is migrated.

raw_findings.body: The generated INSERT is malformed or injects arbitrary SQL, causing the migration to raise a PG::SyntaxError (blocking the upgrade) or to execute unintended statements.
raw_findings.evidence: execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"
raw_findings.failure_mode: SQL statement construction is unsafe and can break or be abused during migration.
raw_findings.impact: The generated INSERT is malformed or injects arbitrary SQL, causing the migration to raise a PG::SyntaxError (blocking the upgrade) or to execute unintended statements.
raw_findings.root_cause: Untrusted stored setting text is interpolated into a raw SQL literal without quoting.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Use a bound/quoted parameter, e.g. `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES (#{ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote(h)}, ...)"`, instead of raw string interpolation.
raw_findings.title: Migration interpolates setting value directly into SQL string
raw_findings.trigger: The legacy `embeddable_hosts` setting contains a value with a single quote or any SQL metacharacter (admin-entered free text, never validated as a hostname).

raw_findings.body: `nil['value']` raises NoMethodError and the migration aborts, breaking `rake db:migrate` on fresh installs.
raw_findings.evidence: category_id = execute("SELECT value FROM site_settings WHERE name = 'uncategorized_category_id'")[0]['value'].to_i
raw_findings.failure_mode: NoMethodError on nil aborts the schema migration.
raw_findings.impact: `nil['value']` raises NoMethodError and the migration aborts, breaking `rake db:migrate` on fresh installs.
raw_findings.root_cause: Second raw SELECT in the new migration assumes at least one row exists.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Fetch `.first` and fall back to a safe default (e.g. `row ? row['value'].to_i : -1`) instead of indexing the result set directly.
raw_findings.title: Fallback query for `uncategorized_category_id` also dereferences a possibly empty result
raw_findings.trigger: Migrating a brand-new database where `db/fixtures/001_categories.rb` (which inserts the `uncategorized_category_id` row) has not yet run, so the SELECT returns no rows.

raw_findings.body: The comparison `lower('eviltrout.com') = 'EvilTrout.com'` fails, so `host_allowed?` returns false and the embed request is rejected with `Discourse::InvalidAccess` even though the host is configured.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Legitimate embedding requests are denied due to case-sensitive host matching.
raw_findings.impact: The comparison `lower('eviltrout.com') = 'EvilTrout.com'` fails, so `host_allowed?` returns false and the embed request is rejected with `Discourse::InvalidAccess` even though the host is configured.
raw_findings.root_cause: New lookup applies case normalization to only one side of the equality comparison.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Downcase the argument as well: `where("lower(host) = ?", host.downcase).first`.
raw_findings.title: `record_for_host` lowercases only the column, not the looked-up host
raw_findings.trigger: A referer or embed URL whose hostname contains uppercase characters, e.g. `http://EvilTrout.com/post`, is checked against a stored host `eviltrout.com`.

raw_findings.body: `nil.sub!` raises NoMethodError inside the validation callback, returning a 500 instead of a validation error response the UI can display.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Unhandled exception during save instead of a validation failure.
raw_findings.impact: `nil.sub!` raises NoMethodError inside the validation callback, returning a 500 instead of a validation error response the UI can display.
raw_findings.root_cause: New callback calls String methods on the attribute without a nil check before validation runs.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Guard the callback, e.g. `return if host.blank?` at the top of the `before_validation` block, and add `validates_presence_of :host`.
raw_findings.title: `before_validation` callback raises NoMethodError when host is nil
raw_findings.trigger: An admin submits the new-host form without typing a host (or any API client POSTs `embeddable_host[host]` as null), so `EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` assigns nil and calls `host.save`.

raw_findings.body: `host` is nil and `save_host` calls `nil.host =`, raising NoMethodError and returning a 500 instead of a 404.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Unhandled NoMethodError produces a 500 response for a missing record.
raw_findings.impact: `host` is nil and `save_host` calls `nil.host =`, raising NoMethodError and returning a 500 instead of a 404.
raw_findings.root_cause: New controller action uses `where(...).first` without handling the nil result.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Use `EmbeddableHost.find(params[:id])` (or return `render_json_error`/404 when the record is missing) before calling `save_host`.
raw_findings.title: `update` action crashes when the embeddable host id does not exist
raw_findings.trigger: A PUT to /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id with an id that was already deleted (e.g. two admin tabs open, or a stale client record).

raw_findings.body: `host` is nil, `nil.destroy` raises NoMethodError, and the client sees a 500 error rather than an idempotent success or 404.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Unhandled NoMethodError produces a 500 response on repeat deletion.
raw_findings.impact: `host` is nil, `nil.destroy` raises NoMethodError, and the client sees a 500 error rather than an idempotent success or 404.
raw_findings.root_cause: New destroy action assumes `where(...).first` always returns a record.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Look the record up with `find` (or return early with a 404/success when `host` is nil) before calling `destroy`.
raw_findings.title: `destroy` action crashes when the embeddable host id does not exist
raw_findings.trigger: A DELETE to /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id for an id that no longer exists (double-click on the delete button, or concurrent admin sessions).

raw_findings.body: The action ignores all request params and only re-renders the freshly fetched OpenStruct, so any client-side save silently succeeds without changing state, misleading callers into believing changes were persisted.
raw_findings.failure_mode: API contract advertises an update that has no effect.
raw_findings.impact: The action ignores all request params and only re-renders the freshly fetched OpenStruct, so any client-side save silently succeeds without changing state, misleading callers into believing changes were persisted.
raw_findings.root_cause: A write endpoint was added whose body duplicates `show` and performs no mutation.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Either implement real persistence for the submitted embedding attributes in `update`, or remove the `put "customize/embedding"` route and the unused `saveChanges` action until the write path exists.
raw_findings.title: Embedding `update` endpoint persists nothing but reports success
raw_findings.trigger: The admin UI calls `this.get('embedding').update({})` (admin-embedding controller `saveChanges`), issuing PUT /admin/customize/embedding.

raw_findings.body: `_lookupSubType` returns undefined for each id, so `obj.foos` becomes an array of `undefined` and the original `foo_ids` are deleted, leaving the model with unusable data and no way to recover the ids (the singular branch, by contrast, keeps `_id` when hydration fails).
raw_findings.failure_mode: Silent data loss/undefined array members in hydrated records.
raw_findings.impact: `_lookupSubType` returns undefined for each id, so `obj.foos` becomes an array of `undefined` and the original `foo_ids` are deleted, leaving the model with unusable data and no way to recover the ids (the singular branch, by contrast, keeps `_id` when hydration fails).
raw_findings.root_cause: New plural branch unconditionally replaces the id list with mapped lookup results without validating that the lookups resolved.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Only assign and delete when every lookup succeeded, e.g. build the array, `if (hydrated.every(h => h))` assign `obj[plural]` and delete `obj[k]`, otherwise leave `obj[k]` untouched; the `|| []` fallback is dead code since `map` always returns an array.
raw_findings.title: Plural embedded hydration discards ids and yields undefined entries when the collection is not sideloaded
raw_findings.trigger: A REST payload contains a `foo_ids` array while the root JSON does not include a matching sideloaded `foos` collection (e.g. a serializer that emits `embed: :ids` without including the objects).

raw_findings.body: The client overwrites `category` with `Discourse.Category.findById(null)` (undefined), so the row's category badge is blank until the page is reloaded, contradicting the persisted value.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Displayed category diverges from persisted category until reload.
raw_findings.impact: The client overwrites `category` with `Discourse.Category.findById(null)` (undefined), so the row's category badge is blank until the page is reloaded, contradicting the persisted value.
raw_findings.root_cause: Post-save UI state is derived from the pre-save local input rather than the server response.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Use the saved record's returned attribute, e.g. resolve the category from the save result payload's `category_id` (or from `host.get('category_id')` after `setProperties`) instead of the local `categoryId`.
raw_findings.title: New host row shows no category when the server assigns the uncategorized default
raw_findings.trigger: An admin adds a host without picking a category, so `categoryId` is null; the server sets `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` and returns it in the response.

raw_findings.body: The route resolves but `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` implements only create/update/destroy, so Rails raises `AbstractController::ActionNotFound` / a missing-template error (500) instead of a clean 404.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Routable URLs raise server errors for unimplemented actions.
raw_findings.impact: The route resolves but `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` implements only create/update/destroy, so Rails raises `AbstractController::ActionNotFound` / a missing-template error (500) instead of a clean 404.
raw_findings.root_cause: Full RESTful resource declared for a controller that implements a subset of actions.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Restrict the resource: `resources :embeddable_hosts, only: [:create, :update, :destroy], constraints: AdminConstraint.new`.
raw_findings.title: `resources :embeddable_hosts` exposes routes with no matching controller actions
raw_findings.trigger: An admin (or crawler) requests GET /admin/embeddable_hosts, /admin/embeddable_hosts/1, /admin/embeddable_hosts/new or /edit.

raw_findings.body: The repository's fabricator-per-file naming convention is violated, making the definitions undiscoverable and breaking any lookup that relies on the `<name>_fabricator.rb` convention.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Test fixtures are stored under misleading filenames, degrading maintainability and convention-based lookup.
raw_findings.impact: The repository's fabricator-per-file naming convention is violated, making the definitions undiscoverable and breaking any lookup that relies on the `<name>_fabricator.rb` convention.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new fabricator was written into the existing category fabricator file while the category definitions were moved into the newly named embeddable_host file.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Swap the file contents back: keep the category fabricators in `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` and put only `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)` in `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb`.
raw_findings.title: Category and embeddable-host fabricators are placed in swapped files
raw_findings.trigger: Any developer looking for the `:category` fabricator opens `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` and finds the embeddable host fabricator, while `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains all the category fabricators.

raw_findings.body: The remaining example asserts `false` only because `embed_truncate` defaults to false; its name claims host-blankness coverage that no longer exists, so a regression in the truncate/embed logic could be misattributed and the host condition is untested.
raw_findings.impact: The remaining example asserts `false` only because `embed_truncate` defaults to false; its name claims host-blankness coverage that no longer exists, so a regression in the truncate/embed logic could be misattributed and the host condition is untested.
raw_findings.root_cause: The setup line was deleted without renaming or removing the example whose description depended on it.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Rename the example to reflect what it now verifies (e.g. "is false when embed_truncate is disabled") or delete it, since `expandable_first_post?` no longer consults embeddable hosts.
raw_findings.title: Test named "is false if embeddable_host is blank" no longer exercises embeddable hosts
raw_findings.trigger: Reading or maintaining the `expandable_first_post?` spec after `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` was removed from the method.

raw_findings.body: RSpec output reads "with an emeddable host", so searches for embeddable-host related specs miss this group.
raw_findings.impact: RSpec output reads "with an emeddable host", so searches for embeddable-host related specs miss this group.

raw_findings.suggested_fix: Correct the spelling to `describe 'with an embeddable host' do`.
raw_findings.title: Typo "emeddable" in new describe block description
raw_findings.trigger: Running the suite or grepping spec output for "embeddable".

raw_findings.body: None of the new behavior is covered: blank host handling (which currently 500s in the model callback), the `uncategorized_category_id` default assignment, and update/destroy with an unknown id all ship untested.

validated_findings.trigger: An admin submits the new-host form without typing a host (or any API client POSTs `embeddable_host[host]` as null), so `EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` assigns nil and calls `host.save`.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Line R6 shows `self.host.sub!(...)` in before_validation. If host attribute is nil (blank form submission), `nil.sub!` raises NoMethodError. No nil guard exists in the callback.

validated_findings.body: `host` is nil and `save_host` calls `nil.host =`, raising NoMethodError and returning a 500 instead of a 404.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Unhandled NoMethodError produces a 500 response for a missing record.
validated_findings.impact: `host` is nil and `save_host` calls `nil.host =`, raising NoMethodError and returning a 500 instead of a 404.
validated_findings.root_cause: New controller action uses `where(...).first` without handling the nil result.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Use `EmbeddableHost.find(params[:id])` (or return `render_json_error`/404 when the record is missing) before calling `save_host`.
validated_findings.title: `update` action crashes when the embeddable host id does not exist
validated_findings.trigger: A PUT to /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id with an id that was already deleted (e.g. two admin tabs open, or a stale client record).
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Lines R10-R11 show `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` then `save_host(host)`. If id doesn't exist, host is nil, and `save_host` calls `host.host =` on nil, raising NoMethodError.

validated_findings.body: `host` is nil, `nil.destroy` raises NoMethodError, and the client sees a 500 error rather than an idempotent success or 404.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Unhandled NoMethodError produces a 500 response on repeat deletion.
validated_findings.impact: `host` is nil, `nil.destroy` raises NoMethodError, and the client sees a 500 error rather than an idempotent success or 404.
validated_findings.root_cause: New destroy action assumes `where(...).first` always returns a record.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Look the record up with `find` (or return early with a 404/success when `host` is nil) before calling `destroy`.
validated_findings.title: `destroy` action crashes when the embeddable host id does not exist
validated_findings.trigger: A DELETE to /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id for an id that no longer exists (double-click on the delete button, or concurrent admin sessions).
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Lines R15-R16 show `host = EmbeddableHost.where(...).first` then `host.destroy`. If record doesn't exist, host is nil and `nil.destroy` raises NoMethodError.

validated_findings.body: The action ignores all request params and only re-renders the freshly fetched OpenStruct, so any client-side save silently succeeds without changing state, misleading callers into believing changes were persisted.
validated_findings.failure_mode: API contract advertises an update that has no effect.
validated_findings.impact: The action ignores all request params and only re-renders the freshly fetched OpenStruct, so any client-side save silently succeeds without changing state, misleading callers into believing changes were persisted.
validated_findings.root_cause: A write endpoint was added whose body duplicates `show` and performs no mutation.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Either implement real persistence for the submitted embedding attributes in `update`, or remove the `put "customize/embedding"` route and the unused `saveChanges` action until the write path exists.
validated_findings.title: Embedding `update` endpoint persists nothing but reports success
validated_findings.trigger: The admin UI calls `this.get('embedding').update({})` (admin-embedding controller `saveChanges`), issuing PUT /admin/customize/embedding.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Lines R9-R10 show `update` action that only calls `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` identical to `show` (R5-R6). No params are read or persisted. The PUT endpoint does nothing but return current state.

validated_findings.body: The client overwrites `category` with `Discourse.Category.findById(null)` (undefined), so the row's category badge is blank until the page is reloaded, contradicting the persisted value.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Displayed category diverges from persisted category until reload.
validated_findings.impact: The client overwrites `category` with `Discourse.Category.findById(null)` (undefined), so the row's category badge is blank until the page is reloaded, contradicting the persisted value.
validated_findings.root_cause: Post-save UI state is derived from the pre-save local input rather than the server response.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Use the saved record's returned attribute, e.g. resolve the category from the save result payload's `category_id` (or from `host.get('category_id')` after `setProperties`) instead of the local `categoryId`.
validated_findings.title: New host row shows no category when the server assigns the uncategorized default
validated_findings.trigger: An admin adds a host without picking a category, so `categoryId` is null; the server sets `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` and returns it in the response.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: The claim assumes server assigns uncategorized default when categoryId is null, but line R38 shows client sets category from local `categoryId`. The server does set default (R25 in controller), but the save response includes category_id which could be used. The UI inconsistency is speculative and low-impact.

validated_findings.body: The route resolves but `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` implements only create/update/destroy, so Rails raises `AbstractController::ActionNotFound` / a missing-template error (500) instead of a clean 404.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Routable URLs raise server errors for unimplemented actions.
validated_findings.impact: The route resolves but `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` implements only create/update/destroy, so Rails raises `AbstractController::ActionNotFound` / a missing-template error (500) instead of a clean 404.
validated_findings.root_cause: Full RESTful resource declared for a controller that implements a subset of actions.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Restrict the resource: `resources :embeddable_hosts, only: [:create, :update, :destroy], constraints: AdminConstraint.new`.
validated_findings.title: `resources :embeddable_hosts` exposes routes with no matching controller actions
validated_findings.trigger: An admin (or crawler) requests GET /admin/embeddable_hosts, /admin/embeddable_hosts/1, /admin/embeddable_hosts/new or /edit.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Line R153 shows `resources :embeddable_hosts` which generates all 7 RESTful routes. Controller only implements create/update/destroy (no index/show/new/edit). GET requests to unimplemented actions will error.

validated_findings.body: The repository's fabricator-per-file naming convention is violated, making the definitions undiscoverable and breaking any lookup that relies on the `<name>_fabricator.rb` convention.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Test fixtures are stored under misleading filenames, degrading maintainability and convention-based lookup.
validated_findings.impact: The repository's fabricator-per-file naming convention is violated, making the definitions undiscoverable and breaking any lookup that relies on the `<name>_fabricator.rb` convention.
validated_findings.root_cause: The new fabricator was written into the existing category fabricator file while the category definitions were moved into the newly named embeddable_host file.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Swap the file contents back: keep the category fabricators in `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` and put only `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)` in `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb`.
validated_findings.title: Category and embeddable-host fabricators are placed in swapped files
validated_findings.trigger: Any developer looking for the `:category` fabricator opens `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` and finds the embeddable host fabricator, while `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains all the category fabricators.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch shows category_fabricator.rb now contains `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)` (R1-R3) while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains category fabricators. The files are swapped, violating naming convention.

validated_findings.body: The remaining example asserts `false` only because `embed_truncate` defaults to false; its name claims host-blankness coverage that no longer exists, so a regression in the truncate/embed logic could be misattributed and the host condition is untested.

validated_findings.body: The assertions for color ids 1 and 2 only pass because the stub ignores the requested id; the test does not verify what it appears to and will break as soon as the pretender is made id-aware.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Test passes for the wrong reason and misrepresents hydration coverage.
validated_findings.impact: The assertions for color ids 1 and 2 only pass because the stub ignores the requested id; the test does not verify what it appears to and will break as soon as the pretender is made id-aware.
validated_findings.root_cause: Test id was changed without updating the pretender handler that hardcodes `fruits[0]`.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Either request `store.find('fruit', 1)` to match the stub, or make the `/fruits/:id` handler look up the fruit by `request.params.id` and assert banana's single color.
validated_findings.title: store-test 'find embedded' requests fruit 2 but asserts fruit 1's colors
validated_findings.trigger: The `/fruits/:id` pretender handler ignores the id and always returns `fruits[0]` (apple, `color_ids: [1,2]`), while the test asks for id 2 (banana, `color_ids: [3]`).
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Lines R111-R117 show test requests fruit id 2 but asserts color_ids [1,2]. Context shows pretender at line 228 returns `fruits[0]` (apple with color_ids [1,2]) regardless of requested id. Test passes for wrong reason.
